methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The EEM framework is a managerial tool that assesses the maturity of an energy-intensive SME on the EE enabling characteristics and assists the SME in chalking out an action plan to enhance the EE.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Maturity-assessment framework without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The study developed an EEM framework for the systematic integration of EE practices in energy-intensive SMEs.

stage1.notes: The paper reports SEC values as case descriptors but does not construct or characterise an EnPI/EnB measurement model.
